name: garth_jones_allegheny_reply
description: Email reply from Garth Jones (Allegheny Aikido, Pittsburgh) to the Ikeda outreach (issue #64), received 2026-09-24. Reports: Ikeda promoted to 8th dan in 2024 or 2025 (year uncertain in his words); Ikeda's first Pittsburgh visit was Three Rivers Aikikai at Carnegie Mellon University in 2001; Ikeda has visited Allegheny Aikido in 2015 and annually 2021-2026, all weekend seminars; a further visit planned 'next August' (August 2027 by email date) with the 2026 flier attached as a sample. Also supplied outreach contacts: Aikido Chuseikan info@tampaaikido.com; Aikido Shobukan Dojo manager@aikido-shobukan.org. Note: all existing graph event listings still say 7th dan — the 8th-dan report is new and uncorroborated.
